dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: Ahh, that familiar fragrance... makes me nostalgic. I remember a similar scent from my younger days...

dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: Coming right up! All freshly caught!

dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: Haha, yeah. Long ago now. When I was young, I once met a girl from Snezhnaya... The fragrance she wore was a little like yours.

dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: Back then, we had faith that... No, never mind. Our faith, for the most part, was a meaningless thing anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: She came from an ancient noble bloodline, you see. In the end, there was simply no way for us to be together. A pearl upon the ocean floor does not wander with the fish of the sea... Such is the way of the world.

dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: *sigh* Guess old age makes one prone to rambling. Sorry to have bothered you.

dialogues.speaker: Andreas
dialogues.text: Safe travels! Fresh fish whenever you need it!
